review_rationale: Source registration for 18.3 and 18.3.1-18.3.6: interoperability of intrinsic types, C pointer types, derived types and C structures, and scalar and array variables (batch242). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; C1801-C1806 had no existing tests, and every correspondence is planned as a mixed Fortran/C program with hand-derived values. 18.3.7 (already on main) is untouched. Source accounting only.
